RELEASE CONTRACT:
• Semantic Versioning: vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (e.g. v1.2.0); git tags are immutable (never overwritten or moved)
• Public repository allows credential-free terraform init without leaking accounts, ARNs, or client data
• Infrastructure stacks consume modules strictly by pinned git tag (never branch or floating ref)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="74" width="2200" x="100" y="3012" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

TRUNK-BASED DEVELOPMENT RULES (AGENTS.md §6):
• Direct commits to main strictly forbidden; short-lived branch lifespan < 48 hours; target PR diff < 400 lines
• Strict Conventional Commits (TYPE(SCOPE): lowercase subject) without emojis and with mandatory Refs footer
• Push only assigned feature branch; peer reviewer or lead approves and squash-merges

• Infracost CLI v2 token (legacy ico- keys rejected); variables INFRACOST_ORG and egress approved required
• Publishes before, after, and delta breakdowns for each root in job summary; missing token outputs 'estimate unavailable'
• Pinning: checksum-pinned CLI download and SHA-pinned GitHub actions; Slack notifications not required

PC-IAC-015 MODULE RELEASE CONTRACT:
• Semantic Versioning: vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (e.g. v1.2.0); git tags are immutable (never overwritten or moved)
• Public repository allows credential-free terraform init without leaking accounts, ARNs, or client data
• Infrastructure stacks consume modules strictly by pinned git tag (never branch or floating ref)
